purpose: Robustness audit of the previously frozen combined Quick Evidence hypothesis after correcting historical replay availability boundaries. This is not a new independent validation set.

corrections.billIdentity: derive historical identity title only from the dated official bill text; never use mutable current bills.title
corrections.billFeatures: recompute deterministic features from dated raw bill text plus the dated-text-derived identity title; ignore persisted historical feature sets that may contain mutable-title inputs
corrections.companionState: use only dated legislative_stage_events companion_reference rows strictly before the target vote; never use current Revisor companion metadata
corrections.billEvidenceDateSanity: exclude reconstructed bill evidence dated before the legislative session start or before the bill introduction date; target-day evidence remains excluded when intraday ordering is unavailable
corrections.fitPopulation: fit member observations only from events the serving Quick replay marks replayable; scoring and fit populations must align

fit.model: multivariable ridge logistic offset on corrected serving Quick replay logit
selectionMetricOrder: validation chamber mean absolute yes-vote error

robustnessReporting.note: Sensitivity outputs are descriptive robustness checks and do not retune the selected lambda.

interpretation.note: The v2 rerun can invalidate or qualify the old retrospective result, but it cannot promote the candidate because the validation outcomes were already observed during the original research.
